name: Air Conditioning & Climate Control
disclaimer: Automotive A/C systems use pressurized refrigerants (R134a, R1234yf) that require EPA-certified recovery and recharge equipment.

symptoms: AC vents blowing ambient or warm air
AC cools slightly while driving on highway but warms up at idle
potentialCauses: Low refrigerant level due to micro-leak
triageQuestions: Does the air get cool at all or is it blowing completely warm?
Do you hear the A/C compressor click on under the hood when you turn AC button on/off?
subtopics.recommendedAction: A/C performance test, UV dye leak detection scan, and precision electronic vacuum recharge.

symptoms: Musty, moldy, or vinegar smell when fan is turned on
potentialCauses: Blocked A/C condensate drain tube causing stagnant water
triageQuestions: When was your cabin air filter last changed (recommended every 12 months/15,000 miles)?
Do you notice wet carpet in the front passenger footwell?
subtopics.recommendedAction: Cabin air filter replacement and evaporator antibacterial foam sanitization treatment.

symptoms: Loud screech/squeal when A/C button is pressed
Rattling noise from front of engine when A/C is active
potentialCauses: Worn or loose A/C compressor serpentine belt
subtopics.criticalWarning: A seized A/C compressor can snap the serpentine belt, causing loss of power steering, alternator charging, and water pump cooling.
triageQuestions: Does the noise immediately disappear when you turn the A/C switch off?
subtopics.recommendedAction: Compressor clutch bearing test and drive belt inspection.

triageRules: Clarify that DIY recharge cans with stop-leak can damage professional A/C recovery machines.
Recommend professional pressure gauge and manifold diagnostic.
